final.answer: The transmitter feeding FIC-10-1 is FT-10-1 (a Rosemount 3051, HART 4-20 mA version). It has no fixed failure direction: on a detected sensor or microprocessor failure the 4-20 mA signal is driven either high or low, and which of the two applies is user-selectable via a jumper/switch on the transmitter [p. 88]. The alarm levels depend on the configuration: standard default is high ≥ 21.75 mA and low ≤ 3.75 mA, NAMUR-compliant (option codes C4/CN) is high ≥ 22.5 mA and low ≤ 3.6 mA, and custom levels (option codes CR/CS, or CT for standard low) can be set at ordering time within 20.2–23.0 mA high and 3.6–3.8 mA low. To change the alarm direction you use that jumper/switch on the transmitter, but the available facts do not describe the step-by-step procedure for doing so.

Seal and ring materials available for it include: PTFE seal rings (PTFE V-ring packing and PTFE/composition plug seals, rated about -73 to 232 °C / -100 to 450 °F; some PTFE V-ring constructions span -101 to 316 °C / -150 to 600 °F with appropriate construction); PTFE/graphite (or PTFE/carbon) seal rings, which may be used with PEEK anti-extrusion rings up to 316 °C / 600 °F in non-oxidizing service or 260 °C / 500 °F in oxidizing service (standard limit 232 °C / 450 °F, extendable above 232 °C / 450 °F only with PEEK rings and spring-loaded seal rings); spring-loaded valve plug seals in PTFE with N10276 spring (approx. -73 to 232 °C / -100 to 450 °F), S30200, S31600 or S41600 stainless steel, or PTFE/graphite with R30003 spring (up to 316 °C / 600 °F for oxidizing service per its note); UHMWPE (R30003) seal rings on ET trim (trim temperature limit -198 to 66 °C / -325 to 150 °F with the 316 SST/ENC cage); and Ethylene-propylene (-40 to 232 °C / -40 to 450 °F), Fluorocarbon (-18 to 204 °C / 0 to 400 °F, not for steam or ammonia), Nitrile (max 71-82 °C / 160-180 °F, for air and hydrocarbons or compatible fluids), and Carbon-filled PTFE (-73 to 232 °C / -100 to 450 °F) for the 2-piece valve plug seal. Supporting rings are made of N05500 (load ring), N07750 (retaining ring for spring-loaded seal ring construction), and PEEK (anti-extrusion rings).
